headline: Asean targets Defa rollout under Singapore’s chairship
summary: ASEAN is targeting implementation of its Digital Economy Framework Agreement in 2027 under Singapore's chairship, Philippine Trade Secretary Ma. Cristina Roque said. All trade ministers reportedly agreed at the summit in Manila.
why: The Digital Economy Framework Agreement sets common digital trade rules across Southeast Asia, which affects cross-border technology and e-commerce businesses in the region.
